title: Stressed All the Time? A Psychologist Explains What's Really Going On

sentences.en: Sometimes we get so used to doing things a certain way that we forget there might be other possibilities.
sentences.zh: 有时候我们太习惯用某种特定方式做事，以至于忘记了可能还有其他的可能性。

sentences.en: That can most definitely apply to our working lives too.
sentences.zh: 这绝对也可以应用到我们的工作中。

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent and one of the biggest changes I've made in my career has been exploring ways to earn money beyond traditional one-to-one work.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，我职业生涯中做过的最大改变之一，就是探索通过传统一对一工作以外的方式来赚钱。

sentences.en: If that sparks your curiosity, Sophie Foote's free Race to Recurring
sentences.zh: 如果这激发了你的好奇心，苏菲·富特的免费“向循环收入冲刺挑战赛”

sentences.en: Revenue Challenge starts on the 2nd of November.
sentences.zh: 将于 11 月 2 日开始。

sentences.en: I'd love you to join us.
sentences.zh: 我很希望你能加入我们。

sentences.en: You'll find my link in the show notes or you can drop me a DM via socials.
sentences.zh: 你会在节目简介中找到我的链接，或者你可以通过社交媒体给我发私信。

sentences.en: Now on with the show.
sentences.zh: 现在开始我们的节目。

sentences.en: Everyone experiences stress from time to time but how do you know when your stress has become too much?
sentences.zh: 每个人都会时不时地经历压力，但你怎么知道你的压力什么时候已经过头了呢？

sentences.en: Is it when you stop sleeping properly?
sentences.zh: 是当你开始无法好好睡觉的时候吗？

sentences.en: When your weekends are spent recovering from the week that's gone before or when you're still functioning but everything feels harder than it should be?
sentences.zh: 是当你的周末都在用来恢复前一周的精力，还是当你还在勉强运转但一切都感觉比应有的更艰难的时候？

sentences.en: And perhaps one of the most important questions is how much of the pressure you're actually carrying belongs to you.
sentences.zh: 也许最重要的问题之一是，你所承担的压力中，到底有多少是真正属于你自己的。

sentences.en: Today I want to help you work out where your stress is coming from, what you can change and when you might want to start taking that more seriously.
sentences.zh: 今天我想帮你弄清楚你的压力从何而来，你能改变什么，以及你什么时候可能需要开始更认真地对待它。

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士

sentences.en: Trent, a clinical psychologist and this is Psychology Actually.
sentences.zh: ，一名临床心理学家，欢迎收听《真实的心理学》。

sentences.en: Before we get started, if you are watching or listening to this, I hope it's because you're a fan of the show, a returning fan of the show.
sentences.zh: 在我们开始之前，如果你正在观看或收听这个节目，我希望这是因为你是本节目的粉丝，是本节目的老粉丝。

sentences.en: I would be so grateful if you've got a moment to just check whether you're already following or subscribing to the channel or the show wherever you're accessing this episode.
sentences.zh: 如果你能花一点时间检查一下你是否已经在你收看本集的任何平台关注或订阅了本频道或本节目，我将不胜感激。

sentences.en: It is totally free.
sentences.zh: 这是完全免费的。

sentences.en: It helps me to help grow this show which I hope is something you already love or something that you will learn to love very soon.
sentences.zh: 这有助于我发展这个节目，我希望这是你已经喜爱的内容，或者你会很快爱上的内容。

sentences.en: Thanks for being here.
sentences.zh: 感谢你的到来。

sentences.en: Now let's take a look at stress.
sentences.zh: 现在让我们来看看压力。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to Psychology Actually.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《真实的心理学》。

sentences.en: I am Dr Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: It's lovely to have you here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能来到这里。

sentences.en: So stress, it is a big one and it affects all of us from time to time, some of us for longer than others.
sentences.zh: 所以压力，这是一个很大的问题，它时不时地影响着我们所有人，有些人受到的影响比其他人更持久。

sentences.en: I think one of the first and most important ideas is to think about where this stress, where
sentences.zh: 我认为首先也是最重要的想法之一，是思考这些压力、这些

sentences.en: this pressure is coming from and from my own experiences both personally and clinically it can be from a variety of different places.
sentences.zh: 压力究竟来自哪里。根据我个人和临床的经验，它们可能来自各种不同的地方。

sentences.en: Often we can be our own worst enemy and it's that self-imposed pressure that might also feel very critical at times as well that we're using to kind of spur
sentences.zh: 通常我们可能是自己最大的敌人，这种自我施加的压力有时也会让人感觉非常严苛，我们用它来鞭策

sentences.en: ourselves on but is actually to our detriment.
sentences.zh: 自己前进，但实际上却对我们有害。

sentences.en: There's a really, really interesting episode on this I did with Professor Paul Gilbert about compassion and the self-critic that I think you'll love.
sentences.zh: 关于这一点，我和保罗·吉尔伯特教授做过一期非常非常有趣的节目，主题是关于同情心和自我批判，我想你会喜欢的。

sentences.en: I will drop details in the show notes or in the description so you can catch up with that one at a later date.
sentences.zh: 我会把详情放在节目简介或描述中，这样你以后就可以去回看那一期了。

sentences.en: If you caught my recent blog series which is the 2007 diaries which were emails that I had
sentences.zh: 如果你看过我最近的博客系列，也就是 2007 年日记，那是我在 2007 年作为一名刚开始职业生涯、努力想进入博士培训的心理学家时

sentences.en: sent my friend in 2007 when I was an early career psychologist trying to get on to doctoral training.
sentences.zh: 发给朋友的电子邮件。

sentences.en: There was a lot of stress, there was a lot of pressure and what I recognised was a lot of it was self-imposed
sentences.zh: 当时有很多压力，有很多心理负担，我意识到其中很大一部分是自我施加的

sentences.en: but as the emails unfold I actually realised that a lot of it was kind of thinking about wanting to try and you know please my mum, make her happy.
sentences.zh: 但随着邮件的展开，我实际上意识到，其中很大一部分其实是想着去尝试，你知道的，讨好我妈妈，让她开心。

sentences.en: What I'm telling you as a 45 year old is
sentences.zh: 我作为一个 45 岁的人想告诉你的是

sentences.en: at some point in your life you've got to put that down, you've got to give up trying, you've got to really think
sentences.zh: 在你人生的某个阶段，你必须放下那些，你必须放弃试图迎合，你必须真正思考

sentences.en: about who it is you're living your life for and whether whether these kind of external metrics or
sentences.zh: 你究竟是为了谁在生活，以及这些外部的衡量标准，或者

sentences.en: what other people think of you or don't think of you is whether that matters really because we can't please people all of the time.
sentences.zh: 别人怎么看你、怎么不看你，这些到底重不重要，因为我们无法做到时时刻刻都讨好所有人。

sentences.en: If we're setting ourselves up for that it's going to lead to hardship for you, it's going to lead to potentially to burnout and to longer term impacts on your mental health and
sentences.zh: 如果我们这样要求自己，将会给自己带来艰难的困境，可能会导致职业倦怠，并对你的心理健康和

sentences.en: wellbeing.
sentences.zh: 福祉产生长期影响。

sentences.en: I'm aware that a lot of pressure can come from your peers as well especially if you're thinking
sentences.zh: 我知道很多压力也可能来自同龄人，尤其是当你认为

sentences.en: that you've got like set ideas about times that you want to be doing things and you see you see people around you doing those things or doing the things that you want to do.
sentences.zh: 自己对想做事情的时间有着固定的想法，而你看到你周围的人在做那些事情，或者在做你想做的事情时。

sentences.en: I'm not immune to that but I do try and hold in mind that old adage comparison is the thief of joy.
sentences.zh: 我对此也并非免疫，但我确实努力记住那句老话：比较是快乐的小偷。

sentences.en: We are different people than even people we've grown up with.
sentences.zh: 我们和那些与我们一同长大的人也是不同的人。

sentences.en: We've had different experiences, we've had different factors that help us, different factors that harm us.
sentences.zh: 我们有不同的经历，有不同的帮助我们的因素，也有不同的伤害我们的因素。

sentences.en: I think even when you're looking at siblings we are not the same people as our siblings.
sentences.zh: 我认为即使你看兄弟姐妹，我们也不是和兄弟姐妹一样的人。

sentences.en: Even I look at my own children who are born two years and ten months apart to the same parents and they have had very different experiences.
sentences.zh: 甚至看看我自己的孩子，他们是同一个父母所生，相差两岁十个月，但他们的经历截然不同。

sentences.en: One of my children we moved house when he was ten months old and it was a very much kind of before
sentences.zh: 我的其中一个孩子，我们在他十个月大时搬了家，那是一个非常明显的

sentences.en: and after phase of that but also with me being a second time parent you know the second time around
sentences.zh: 前后分水岭阶段，但也是因为我是第二次当父母，你知道的，第二次经历这一切

sentences.en: and with my dad being unwell with cancer when I was pregnant with my second child.
sentences.zh: 而且在我怀第二个孩子时，我父亲因患癌症身体不适。

sentences.en: My experience even of pregnancy and of giving birth and kind of recovering was very different both times around especially because I already had an older child.
sentences.zh: 我两次怀孕、生孩子以及恢复的经历都非常不同，特别是由于我当时已经有了一个大孩子。

sentences.en: So I think we can definitely think we should be the same as our siblings or we should be following the same trajectory but sometimes we forget to think
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得我们绝对会认为我们应该和兄弟姐妹一样，或者我们应该遵循相同的轨迹，但有时我们忘记去思考

sentences.en: do I even want what my sibling wants?
sentences.zh: 我甚至真的想要我兄弟姐妹想要的东西吗？

sentences.en: Do I even find the same things appealing?
sentences.zh: 我甚至觉得同样的事情有吸引力吗？

sentences.en: And it's like well no.
sentences.zh: 答案是，并没有。

sentences.en: So is that a race that you're willing to run?
sentences.zh: 所以，那是一场你愿意去跑的赛跑吗？

sentences.en: The same with your peers.
sentences.zh: 你的同龄人也是如此。

sentences.en: So if you're striving for the same profession, the same career then of course it can make you feel like you are more comparable but
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你在争取同样的职业、同样的行业，那么这当然会让你觉得自己更有可比性，但是

sentences.en: I really do when I reflect on my own career I do think that I got for example onto clinical
sentences.zh: 当我反思自己的职业生涯时，我真的认为，例如我在自己准备好的时候

sentences.en: training at the point when I was ready for it but I definitely added to the stress and the pressure
sentences.zh: 进入了临床培训，但我绝对是通过让自己

sentences.en: by you know making myself apply for it sooner than realistically I was going to be able to do well.
sentences.zh: 比现实中能够做好准备时更早地申请，从而增加了压力和负担。

sentences.en: If by chance I'd been given a place to train as a clinical psychologist a year certainly two years earlier I would have floundered because I wasn't ready.
sentences.zh: 如果偶然间我早了一年甚至两年获得临床心理学培训的名额，我会彻底不知所措，因为我当时还没准备好。

sentences.en: So it's really worth thinking about your own career, your own experiences when it comes to that stress, when it comes to that pressure.
sentences.zh: 所以在面对这种压力、面对这种负担时，真的值得好好思考你自己的职业生涯和你自己的经历。

sentences.en: Am I genuinely wanting this right now?
sentences.zh: 我现在真的是发自内心地想要这个吗？

sentences.en: Do I genuinely feel like I'm ready or maybe am I chancing my arm and if I am why am I doing that?
sentences.zh: 我真的觉得自己准备好了吗？还是说我在碰运气？如果我是，我为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: Why not be more mindful?
sentences.zh: 为什么不更有觉察力一些呢？

sentences.en: Why not be more intentional about striving for these goals when the time is genuinely right for me?
sentences.zh: 为什么不在真正适合我的时机，更有意向地去争取这些目标呢？

sentences.en: You might feel pressure from colleagues, from managers, from people in your team.
sentences.zh: 你可能会感受到来自同事、管理者以及团队中其他人的压力。

sentences.en: You might feel pressure because you've got children or because you want to have children or you want to find a partner or someone to settle down with in order to have children.
sentences.zh: 你可能会因为有了孩子、或者因为想要孩子、或者因为想找个伴侣或安定下来生孩子而感受到压力。

sentences.en: You might find pressure because you think I should be living by myself by now, I should be renting my own place, I should be buying my own place.
sentences.zh: 你可能会因为觉得“我到现在应该一个人住了”、“我应该租属于自己的房子了”、“我应该买自己的房子了”而感受到压力。

sentences.en: The shoulds, the shoulds, the shoulds, the shoulds.
sentences.zh: 那些“应该”、那些“应该”、那些“应该”、那些“应该”。

sentences.en: That's a lot before we even begin to take into account your own health, the health of anyone around you, whether you've got dependents that need you.
sentences.zh: 在开始考虑你自己的健康、你周围任何人的健康、你是否有需要你的家属之前，这已经够让人受的了。

sentences.en: It is a lot, a lot indeed.
sentences.zh: 这确实是太不容易了。

sentences.en: So yeah, let's just have that little bit of audit to think about where that pressure
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，让我们稍微盘点一下，思考一下这种压力

sentences.en: is coming from, whether it's self-imposed, whether it's coming from somewhere else and just have that audit to start off with.
sentences.zh: 究竟从何而来，它是自我施加的，还是来自其他地方，先做个这样的盘点吧。

sentences.en: Okay, so once we've done our little check-in and our audit, we're going to look at how much of this stress, how much of this pressure is controllable right now.
sentences.zh: 好了，一旦我们完成了自我检查和盘点，我们就要来看看，这种压力和负担有多少是此时此刻可以控制的。

sentences.en: What can you change?
sentences.zh: 你能改变什么？

sentences.en: What can you influence?
sentences.zh: 你能影响什么？

sentences.en: What do you maybe need to accept right now or find a workaround for?
sentences.zh: 你现在可能需要接受什么，或者需要为之找到什么变通的办法？

sentences.en: I think this can be a really big factor.
sentences.zh: 我认为这可能是一个非常关键的因素。

sentences.en: We can be really, really awful to ourselves when actually so many of the things that make life stressful for us, we might have very little control over.
sentences.zh: 我们对自己可能会非常非常苛刻，而实际上，生活中给我们带来压力的那么多事情，我们可能几乎无法控制。

sentences.en: But again, some of those pressures, you know, really examining those shoulds.
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，其中的一些压力，你知道的，确实需要好好审视那些“应该”。

sentences.en: For example, if you're living independently at the moment and you're finding a bit of a financial struggle, thinking about where that pressure is coming from.
sentences.zh: 举个例子，如果你目前是独立居住，并且发现经济上有点挣扎，那就思考一下这种压力是从哪里来的。

sentences.en: Is there a should, you know, what stops you from getting a housemate or, you know, taking a step in a different direction and renting rather than
sentences.zh: 是不是有什么“应该”在作祟？是什么阻止了你去找个室友，或者，你知道的，采取不同的方向去租房而不是

sentences.en: owning or moving in with another friend, moving in with family members, just to allow yourself to to get back on your feet, really.
sentences.zh: 买房，或者跟另一个朋友合租、搬去和家人同住，仅仅是为了让自己能够重新振作起来。

sentences.en: And, you know, you might treat that as a fixed period of time.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，你可以把这当作一个固定期限的事。

sentences.en: You're not saying, I'm going to go and do that forever.
sentences.zh: 你并不是说：我要永远这样过下去。

sentences.en: But I think we can really relieve the pressure on ourselves when we just allow ourselves to do things, you know, for a few days, for a few
sentences.zh: 但我认为，当我们只允许自己去做几天、

sentences.en: weeks, for a few months, we set limits around that.
sentences.zh: 几周、几个月的事情，并为此设定界限时，我们真的可以减轻自身的压力。

sentences.en: And then we can re-examine, you know, perhaps when the dust has settled and just check whether we're still going to make the same decisions again.
sentences.zh: 然后，等尘埃落定之后，我们可以重新审视，你知道的，并检查我们是否还会做出同样的决定。

sentences.en: And I guess reduce some of that shame, take some of that shame away.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是为了减少一些羞耻感，卸下一部分羞耻心。

sentences.en: So, for example, if you are making a change in a job or in a living situation or even a relationship, just be like,
sentences.zh: 所以，举个例子，如果你在工作、居住环境甚至感情上做出了改变，只需这样想：

sentences.en: well, I couldn't have known what I know now, before, when I didn't have that context, I didn't have that experience, I didn't have that understanding.
sentences.zh: “好吧，我以前在没有那个背景、没有那个经历、没有那个理解的时候，不可能知道我现在所知道的。”

sentences.en: But now, now I'm here, I do.
sentences.zh: “但现在，既然我来到了这里，我知道了。”

sentences.en: And I can now make a different decision based on having all of the information available to me.
sentences.zh: “我现在的确可以根据手头掌握的所有信息做出不同的决定。”

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And the next section is where we're going to look at whether this stress you're experiencing is acute or chronic.
sentences.zh: 接下来我们要探讨的是，你所经历的这种压力到底是急性的还是慢性的。

sentences.en: And I'm going to share a little anecdote here to make you feel better about yourself.
sentences.zh: 这里我要分享一个小插曲，让你感觉好受一点。

sentences.en: I was once in an interview for an assistant psychologist for an acute inpatient unit.
sentences.zh: 我曾经去一家急性住院部面试过助理心理学家。

sentences.en: You might be like, I don't know what that is.
sentences.zh: 你可能会想：我不知道那是什么。

sentences.en: Now, if you're going to an interview, do make sure that you know what the terms mean in the job title itself.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果你要去面试，一定要确保你懂职称本身那些术语的含义。

sentences.en: Because I found myself in the very uncomfortable position of someone saying, you know, what is different about acute work to normal work.
sentences.zh: 因为我当时发现自己处在一个非常尴尬的境地，有人问我：急性工作和正常工作有什么区别。

sentences.en: And I was, I was found lacking.
sentences.zh: 结果我被难倒了。

sentences.en: And, oh, you know, well, acute, it's really, it's really bad, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 然后我说：“哦，你知道的，急性嘛，就是真的很严重，对吧？”

sentences.en: No, that is not what acute means.
sentences.zh: 不，那根本不是急性的意思。

sentences.en: Acute means kind of sudden onset without warning, you know, out of the blue.
sentences.zh: 急性是指某种毫无预兆的突然发作，你知道的，突如其来的情况。

sentences.en: That's kind of what acute means was the opposite of that would be a chronic condition.
sentences.zh: 这就是急性的含义，而它的反义词就是慢性病。

sentences.en: So for example, you might have a chronic condition in your mental health, like bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, something like that, that is, it's going to be with you, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以例如，你的心理健康可能有一种慢性状况，比如双相情感障碍、精神分裂症之类的，它会一直伴随着你，你知道的，

sentences.en: same as diabetes, you know, chronic health condition.
sentences.zh: 就像糖尿病一样，你知道的，这是一种慢性健康状况。

sentences.en: But something acute might be, you know, a sudden upset stomach, winter vomiting bug, or, you know, even a broken arm, you know,
sentences.zh: 但急性的情况可能是，你知道的，突然胃部不适、冬季呕吐病毒，或者，你知道的，甚至是骨折，你知道的

sentences.en: I broke my hand recently, that was an acute injury, something that came out of the blue, that we'd expect to be able to work through it.
sentences.zh: 我最近手骨折了，那就是一次急性损伤，一件突如其来的事，我们预期能够挺过去。

sentences.en: But of course, when we're working with people for acute difficulties, they do have different needs than they would do with a chronic condition,
sentences.zh: 但当然，当我们为有急性困难的人提供服务时，他们的需求确实与慢性状况不同，

sentences.en: because we're needing to probably educate the person themselves a little bit about this, stress in the way that we might not necessarily need to do with something chronic.
sentences.zh: 因为我们可能需要向当事人普及一些关于这种压力的知识，而这是我们在面对某种慢性状况时未必需要去做的。

sentences.en: The same is true with you and stress.
sentences.zh: 你和压力也是如此。

sentences.en: If this is something that you're just kind of getting used to noticing, and it's not really been around for you before, we may need to educate you a little bit about what
sentences.zh: 如果这只是你开始习惯注意到的一种情况，而且以前并没有真正困扰过你，我们可能就需要向你普及一些知识，告诉你什么是

sentences.en: stress is, and how much of that is, you know, just gonna happen, and you've got to put up with it.
sentences.zh: 压力，以及其中有多少是你知道的、必然会发生而你必须忍受的。

sentences.en: So that's really what the focus of this video is to allow you to take a little bit of an audit and see what changes you could make.
sentences.zh: 所以这其实就是本视频的重点，让你做个小小的盘点，看看你能做出什么改变。

sentences.en: When it comes to thinking about whether it's a short term period of stress or a long term period of stress, what we might notice is that our sleep might be impacted,
sentences.zh: 当考虑到这是一段短期压力还是长期压力时，我们可能会注意到，我们的睡眠可能会受到影响，

sentences.en: our appetite, even our kind of sexual desires, if we're feeling really stressed might be different than they usually are.
sentences.zh: 我们的食欲，甚至我们对性的渴望，如果我们感到压力山大，也可能会跟平时有所不同。

sentences.en: You might notice it in your shoulders.
sentences.zh: 你可能会在你的肩膀上注意到它。

sentences.en: That's where I notice it.
sentences.zh: 我就是在那儿注意到的。

sentences.en: And I notice it in my breathing as well.
sentences.zh: 我也会在我的呼吸中注意到它。

sentences.en: I'll be like, come on, Marianne, take a breath.
sentences.zh: 我会对自己说：得了吧，玛丽安，吸口气。

sentences.en: Just taking a moment to really check in with my own window of tolerance.
sentences.zh: 花点时间真正审视一下我自己的容忍窗口。

sentences.en: And sometimes I'll do that soothing rhythm breathing cycle.
sentences.zh: 有时我会做那种舒缓的节奏呼吸循环。

sentences.en: So in through the nose, hold it for a moment out through the mouth, hold that for a moment.
sentences.zh: 也就是通过鼻子吸气，屏住呼吸一会儿，通过嘴巴呼气，再屏住呼吸一会儿。

sentences.en: I might do that three times just to reset myself to get myself firmly back comfortably, hopefully, within my window of tolerance.
sentences.zh: 我可能会这样做三次，只是为了重置自己，让自己坚定、舒适地，最好是回到我的容忍窗口之内。

sentences.en: I notice when I've got that tension in my shoulders, I can have a tendency to wear my shoulders as earrings, but they make much better shoulders than they do earrings.
sentences.zh: 我发现当肩膀紧绷时，我往往会把肩膀耸得像耳环一样高，但肩膀可比耳环好用多了。

sentences.en: So just checking in with my body, noticing whether I'm holding any tension in my jaw, and then I guess looking at how my concentration is as well.
sentences.zh: 所以只要内观一下自己的身体，注意我是否在下巴上积蓄了任何紧张感，然后我想还要看看我的注意力如何。

sentences.en: If you feel like your thoughts are moving a million miles a minute, that can be really hard and can be an indication of stress.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得自己的思绪在一分钟内狂飙百万英里，那会非常难受，这可能是压力的一个迹象。

sentences.en: I want to just pay a quick check in to your physical health, to your heart, to your blood pressure.
sentences.zh: 我想顺便检查一下你的身体健康、你的心脏、你的血压。

sentences.en: If you feel like maybe things aren't quite so healthy for you right now, and your stress levels are high, please do consider getting
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得现在情况可能没那么健康，而且你的压力水平很高，请考虑去测量一下血压，

sentences.en: a blood pressure meter reading, which usually you can do by popping into a local pharmacy, and they'll do that for you for free.
sentences.zh: 通常你可以通过走进当地的药房来做到这一点，他们会免费为你检测。

sentences.en: And if there's any problem with your blood pressure, they'll be able to give you the next steps that you might well take, which could involve
sentences.zh: 如果你的血压有任何问题，他们将能够为你提供接下来可能采取的步骤，这可能包括

sentences.en: booking an appointment with your nurse practitioner at your GP surgery if you're in the UK, or alternatively with your GP.
sentences.zh: 如果你在英国，可以预约全科医生诊所的执业护士，或者也可以预约你的全科医生。

sentences.en: But we do know that stress can impact on our physical health.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实知道压力会影响我们的身体健康。

sentences.en: So please make sure if you're concerned about any symptoms that you do check those out.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你对任何症状感到担忧，请确保去检查一下。

sentences.en: Okay, let's think about the costs of this, because I think we can very much delude ourselves that it's okay, like we can keep doing this to ourselves.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们来想想这其中的代价，因为我认为我们很容易自欺欺人地认为这没问题，就像我们可以一直这样对自己一样。

sentences.en: But when we really take a little bit of a laser focus in and look at what the costs of this stress to you are, I think it can really help put things in perspective.
sentences.zh: 但当我们真正集中焦点，看看这种压力对你造成的代价时，我认为这确实能帮我们把事情看透彻。

sentences.en: For me, sleep is a big one, I'm not usually willing to squeeze my sleep, because it makes me more rubbish in all other areas of my life.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，睡眠是一个大事，我通常不愿意压缩睡眠时间，因为它会让我在生活中其他所有方面都变得更糟糕。

sentences.en: I'm a much worse parent, I'm a much poorer quality, more irritable wife when I haven't slept.
sentences.zh: 当我没睡好时，我是一个糟糕得多的父母，是一个质量更差、更易怒的妻子。

sentences.en: So it's just in everybody's best interest if Marianne gets at least eight hours of sleep a night, because I'm just, I can be foul without it.
sentences.zh: 所以玛丽安每晚至少睡八小时对所有人都有好处，因为没有充足睡眠的话，我的脾气可能会很糟糕。

sentences.en: I do not cope well in heat.
sentences.zh: 我不太能忍受炎热。

sentences.en: So, you know, I try and keep a fan around, especially when it's been very hot lately.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我尽量在身边备着风扇，尤其是最近天气非常热的时候。

sentences.en: If you want to get a sensible answer out of me, don't keep me hot.
sentences.zh: 如果你想从我这里得到一个理智的回答，就别让我处在炎热中。

sentences.en: And don't make me overtired, because frankly, those are not good conditions for me.
sentences.zh: 也别让我过度疲劳，因为坦白说，这些对我都不是好状态。

sentences.en: So if you're constantly overtired, you know, that then becomes a chronic condition in itself.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你经常过度疲劳，你知道的，那本身就会变成一种慢性状况。

sentences.en: So, you know, I have to be quite bounded about myself, I put my phone to sleep at 9.40 every night, the screen goes dark, and that tries to act as a
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我对自己的要求必须有界限，我每晚 9 点 40 分会让手机“入睡”，屏幕变黑，这试图起到

sentences.en: little bit of a reminder, don't go on me, don't go on here, you know, I'm dead to you.
sentences.zh: 一点提醒作用：别玩我，别上这儿来，你知道的，我对你来说已经“死”了。

sentences.en: Similarly,
sentences.zh: 同样地，

sentences.en: I've got a reminder on my watch telling me to go to bed, you know, at the same time, really 9.40,
sentences.zh: 我的手表上设有一个提醒，提示我该睡觉了，你知道的，差不多也是在那个时间，9点40分，

sentences.en: I mean, I'm fairly entrenched in my habits now.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我现在的生活习惯已经相当稳固了。

sentences.en: I couldn't believe it when I was on training for the first time.
sentences.zh: 我第一次参加培训的时候，简直难以置信。

sentences.en: And my supervisor at the time told me that she went to bed at 9 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 当时我的主管告诉我，她9点钟就睡觉了。

sentences.en: I was like, you what?
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，你说什么？

sentences.en: I think, you what?
sentences.zh: 我想，你说什么？

sentences.en: But absolutely, when I was in the thick of it with my children, being very young, and I was managing working full time, I used to go to bed at 8.45.
sentences.zh: 但绝对是的，当我深陷于照顾年幼孩子的焦头烂额之中，还要兼顾全职工作时，我通常8点45分就上床睡觉了。

sentences.en: And I just, I couldn't think of any way around it.
sentences.zh: 我当时真的是，完全想不出别的办法。

sentences.en: But those were the factors that I could control, the things that I could change.
sentences.zh: 但那些是我能够控制的因素，是我能够改变的事情。

sentences.en: What I couldn't change was the fact that my child, my youngest child is a really early riser.
sentences.zh: 我无法改变的事实是，我的孩子，我最小的孩子是个起得极早的人。

sentences.en: And you know, before he started sleeping through, he would wake many, many times, like seven times a night.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道的，在他开始整夜睡觉之前，他会醒来很多很多次，比如一晚上醒七次。

sentences.en: So just if I could try and get like an early chunk of sleep, sleep, so I could be asleep before midnight, you know, for a good few hours before midnight,
sentences.zh: 所以只要我能试着争取一大段早一点的睡眠，这样我就能在午夜之前入睡，你知道的，在午夜之前能睡上好几个小时，

sentences.en: hopefully, if he wasn't waking up at that point, it would just feel like I'd put a little bit more energy, tokens, deposits into that bank.
sentences.zh: 希望如果那时他没有醒来，就会感觉像是给那个银行存入了一点额外的能量、筹码和存款。

sentences.en: And if you're having this acute,
sentences.zh: 如果你正在经历这种急性的、

sentences.en: stressful experience, it's whether you can kind of lean into just making some short term changes to
sentences.zh: 有压力的体验，问题在于你是否能够顺应趋势，对你的睡眠做出一些短期改变，

sentences.en: your sleep, which might make a big, big difference for you might even be that you need to make longer
sentences.zh: 这可能会带来非常非常大的不同，甚至可能需要你做出长期的改变，如果你总是处于睡眠赤字状态的话，看你是否能这样想：其实，我，

sentences.en: term changes if you're always in sleep deficit, whether you can just be like, actually, I,
sentences.zh: 我在乎现在的自己，但我也在乎未来的自己，你知道的，我不认为我来到这里只是为了快活一阵子，我更希望我是为了长久地生活下去。

sentences.en: I care about current me, but I also care about future me, you know, I don't think I am just here for, for a good time, I would hope to think that I'm here for a long time.
sentences.zh: 因此，我需要投资于我自己的、我自己的、我自己的身体健康、身心福祉，真的，这就是我想表达的。

sentences.en: And therefore, I need to invest in my own, my own, my own physical health, wellness, really, that's what I'm saying.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，为什么你可以靠每天睡五个半小时甚至更少来维持生活，

sentences.en: So, you know, why is it okay for you to exist on five and a half hours sleep, or less sometimes,
sentences.zh: 因为你想熬夜刷手机，或者你觉得在一天结束时你需要一些属于自己的时间。

sentences.en: because you want to be up scrolling, or you feel like you need some time to yourself at the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我需要把时间投资在睡眠上。

sentences.en: For me, I needed to invest that time in sleep.
sentences.zh: 这确实意味着每一天都可能显得有点单调，特别是当孩子们还小的时候，感觉自己未必

sentences.en: And it did mean that every day could feel a little bit monotonous, especially when the children were young, it didn't feel like I'd necessarily
sentences.zh: 取得了什么成就，也没有那种放松的“啊”的感觉，但在那些短暂的时间里，

sentences.en: achieved like a thing, or have that kind of relaxing sense of, ah, but for those short period of time,
sentences.zh: 虽然我知道当你有孩子时，这些时间可能会感觉很长，但我需要把我的闲暇时间——也就是孩子们不需要我随时陪伴的时间——用来睡觉。

sentences.en: although I know when you've got children, they can feel like long periods of time, I needed to spend my downtime where I wasn't immediately being needed by my kids sleeping.
sentences.zh: 对我和我而言，情况基本上就是这样归结出来的。

sentences.en: That's kind of how it boiled down for me.
sentences.zh: 因为如果我们精疲力竭，那么我们的身体健康很可能也会受到影响。

sentences.en: Because if we are knackered, then our physical health might well be impacted on as well.
sentences.zh: 所以我们的压力以及我们的某种短期习惯，比如我们是否会通过多喝几杯来应对压力、缓解不良情绪，

sentences.en: So our stress and our kind of short term habits, whether we might be drinking more units to cope
sentences.zh: 这都会影响我们的身体健康和身心福祉，

sentences.en: with our stress, the way we feel, that can impact on our physical health, our wellbeing,
sentences.zh: 当然，这也会偷走我们的睡眠，因为在我们代谢掉任何酒精之前，我们是无法开始从睡眠中受益的。

sentences.en: that steals from our sleep as well, of course, because we don't begin to start to get the benefit from sleep until we've processed any units of alcohol.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，所有这些压力，当我们考虑到付出的代价时，它简直是个快乐小偷，对吧？

sentences.en: And, you know, all of this stress, you know, when we're thinking about the costs, it's a joy stealer, right?
sentences.zh: 它不会让生活感觉很有乐趣，除非，当然，你在追求多巴胺带来的奖赏。

sentences.en: It's not going to make life feel very enjoyable, unless, of course, you're looking at dopamine rewards.
sentences.zh: 如果你经历了一段急性的压力期，随之而来的是，你知道的，要么是短效的多巴胺刺激，要么是某种东西带来的奖励，

sentences.en: If you've got acute periods of stress followed by, you know, either a short acting dopamine hit, a reward for something that you get,
sentences.zh: 在短期内你可能会觉得这还可以。

sentences.en: that might feel like that's okay in a short term.
sentences.zh: 但从长远来看，我们真的需要意识到，生活本该是让人感到快乐的。

sentences.en: But in longer term, we really do need to think that life is supposed to feel enjoyable.
sentences.zh: 它不应该全都是压力，持续不断、没完没了的压力，因为那会把你的精力耗尽。

sentences.en: It's not supposed to be all about stress, constant, constant, constant, because that will wear you down.
sentences.zh: 那会影响你的人际关系，无论是和朋友、家人，还是可能你的亲密关系、伴侣、孩子。

sentences.en: That will impact on your relationships, both with your friends, with your family, maybe your intimate relationships, your partners, your children.
sentences.zh: 易怒可一点都不好玩。

sentences.en: Irritability is not fun.
sentences.zh: 我们最不希望看到的是，你总是感觉自己情绪此起彼伏、不断波动。

sentences.en: And what we don't want is for you to constantly feel like you're ebbing and flowing.
sentences.zh: 早上出门时，你好不容易让自己恢复到能再次出发的状态。

sentences.en: You're getting yourself back to feeling like you're able to go again by the time you're walking out the front door in the morning.
sentences.zh: 但等你再次回到家时，你压力山大、不知所措、精疲力竭，以至于你不得不花上整段的时间来重新

sentences.en: But then by the time you come home again, you're so stressed, you're so overwhelmed, you're so depleted that you then got to spend the whole time putting yourself
sentences.zh: 把破碎的自己拼凑起来。

sentences.en: back together again.
sentences.zh: 我真的只是想鼓励大家稍微反思一下，生活是否非得如此，

sentences.en: I would really just encourage a little bit of reflection about whether it needs to
sentences.zh: 以及是否存在你可以采取的任何因素，好让事情感觉更在你游刃有余的掌控之中。

sentences.en: be that way and whether there are any factors you can do so that things feel more comfortably within your stride.
sentences.zh: 同时，我们也值得看一看，这种长期的压力是否可能导致我们所说的“职业倦怠”的出现。

sentences.en: It's also worth having a look at when this longer term stress might be contributing to a presentation of what we call burnout.
sentences.zh: 我没有时间在这里详细讨论这个，但我曾与克莱·普拉姆利博士（Dr. Clare Plumley）合作过一个非常精彩的系列节目，叫做《倦怠点滴》（Burnout Bites），

sentences.en: I don't have time to cover that here, but I did a really lovely series called Burnout Bites with Dr. Clare Plumley, which is all about what burnout is and how it differs
sentences.zh: 内容全关于什么是倦怠，以及它与包括压力在内的许多不同事物有何区别。

sentences.en: to a number of different things, including stress.
sentences.zh: 详细信息将在节目文稿和简介中列出。

sentences.en: There'll be details in the show notes and in the description.
sentences.zh: 显而易见却被忽视的问题可能是，如果你现在正在工作，这种压力可能意味着实际上你需要请一段时间的假，

sentences.en: And the elephant in the room might be that if you are working right now, this stress might mean
sentences.zh: 以便你能处理一些生活中的因素，把事情理顺，从而对你自己好一点，争取到喘息的空间，

sentences.en: that actually you need to take a period of time off work so that you can address some life factors,
sentences.zh: 让自己真正感觉好起来，这样无论你的工作是什么，你都会觉得它是你所期待的、你所享受的事情。

sentences.en: so that you can sort things out, so that you can be kinder to yourself and get that breathing space to
sentences.zh: 同样地，你知道的，如果压力来自于育儿、孩子，或者你的朋友、家人，你该如何寻求帮助，

sentences.en: feel really well so that whatever your job is, that you feel like it's something that you are looking forward to, that you are enjoying.
sentences.zh: 给自己留出一些时间来做出一些改变，让事情感觉更舒适、更容易实现，不再让你感到被掏空，而是更像在丰富你的生活。

sentences.en: And the same thing with, you know, if the stress is coming from parenting or children or, you know, your friends, your family, how can you ask for help to allow
sentences.zh: 在我们结束之前，我想快速抛出几个需要思考的点。

sentences.en: yourself some time to make some changes to help things feel more comfortable, more achievable and less like they're depleting you, more like they are enriching you.
sentences.zh: 第一，压力也可能来自于我们自身的个人价值观，以及我们觉得自己在这些价值观面前表现得如何。

sentences.en: Just before we finish, I want to have a little bit of a kind of quick fire consideration.
sentences.zh: 因此，做一个基于价值观的小练习会非常有帮助。

sentences.en: Number one, stress can come from our own personal values as well and how we feel that we're measuring up against them.
sentences.zh: 如果你想要一份完整的价值观清单，你可以在谷歌上搜索“act 完整价值观清单”，这就会为你呈现出来。

sentences.en: So doing a little bit of a values based exercise can be really helpful.
sentences.zh: 你可以对照着检查一下，你认为自己的人生、人际关系、工作以及许多不同生活领域的核心价值观是什么。

sentences.en: If you'd like a full list of values, you can Google act full list values that will bring that up for you.
sentences.zh: 因为有时压力可能正是那种冲突，与我们价值观的碰撞，因为感觉我们并没有按照真实的自我去生活。

sentences.en: And you can have a little check off about what you think your personal values are for your life, for your relationships, for your work, for many different life domains.
sentences.zh: 接下来是，高功能压力依然是压力。

sentences.en: Because sometimes that stress can be that conflict, that clash with our values because it doesn't feel like we're living to our authentic self.
sentences.zh: 尽管你把所有的事情都完成了，但这并不意味着这就没问题。

sentences.en: Next is that high functioning stress is still stress.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你效率很高，但这并不意味着这应该成为你的常态。

sentences.en: Even though you're getting all of your stuff done, it doesn't mean that that's okay.
sentences.zh: 思考一下我们的周末，它们是否只是在偿还“恢复债”。

sentences.en: It means that you're very efficient, but it doesn't mean that that should be your norm.
sentences.zh: 这很像你在周中时可能会感到的那样，你觉得你只是在苦苦支撑，然后在周末你只需要充电和休息，

sentences.en: Thinking about our weekends and whether they are just a recovery debt.
sentences.zh: 以便你能在身体上继续应付你的，你知道的，周一早上的任务。

sentences.en: So very much like they might be in the midweek where you feel that you're just like, and then at the weekend you just need to recharge and rest yourself so that you
sentences.zh: 其实真不应该是这样的。

sentences.en: can physically carry on with your, you know, your Monday morning tasks.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为周末应该是一种与你的工作周结构截然不同的生活方式。

sentences.en: It shouldn't really be that way.
sentences.zh: 做你喜欢的事，做那些能让你精神饱满、充满期待的事，当然也少不了适当的休息和充电。

sentences.en: I do think that weekend should be a way of having a very different structure than your work week structure.
sentences.zh: 但这不应该只是一种不断起伏的循环。

sentences.en: But things that you enjoy, things that build you up, things that you look forward to, as well as of course some rest and recharge.
